body: r33-provider (2026-10-07): plugin/oauthprovider (no third-party deps) issues opaque access tokens only so far; refresh-token reuse interval is 0 (a reused refresh token is refused at once); a provider access token is not an app session. Core hook auth.OpInfo.SelfServed (wired, not mounted by transports). r31 also flagged: SAML metadata is answered wrapped in JSON; SAML responses are not tied to the starting browser (the feature checklist same).
